exposure: prematurity-related brain lesions (periventricular leukomalacia, germinal matrix hemorrhage)
outcome: spatial distribution of grey matter (GM) CBF
cohort: The study included 66 preterm newborns (51 without and 15 with prematurity-related brain lesions) and 38 full-term newborns, all assessed at term-equivalent age.
finding: Prematurity and prematurity-related brain injury heterogeneously affect brain perfusion, with GM perfusion associated with gestational age at birth in specific brain regions and brain lesions linked to altered perfusion patterns.
gest_age: Preterm and full-term neonates, with gestational age at birth being an investigated variable.
